messages.author: Kaisa Kaapeli
messages.text: Morning Olli. TRN-051 check is finished, nothing to report there. While I have you, a question about a different unit from yesterday's round, the one with the fan tray alarm.

messages.author: Kaisa Kaapeli
messages.text: I don't have the tag with me, the photo is on my other phone. Not TRN-051, that one was clean. The alarm comes and goes and the tray sounds rough.

messages.author: Olli Optikko
messages.text: For that one I'd reseat the tray before ordering anything. In my experience an alarm that comes and goes is usually dust on the tray connector rather than a dead fan. If it comes back within a day the tray probably needs replacing.

messages.author: Kaisa Kaapeli
messages.text: OK, I'll try that when I'm back there.
